lens: Performance — latency, throughput, complexity, hot-path impact
answer: PR #15 is a path-rename for capability templates (product-control/capabilities → registry/capability-templates) plus 5 ADR amendments + doc moves. The two dev-cli source touches (foundry_capability_schema_gates.rs, foundry_eval_gates.rs) are PathBuf::from default-string swaps — no algorithmic change, no hot-path complexity delta. Six committed .omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.<UUID> stowaway files (~55KB total) increase per-commit git pack size unless gitignored; at the recurrence rate observed across PRs 12-18, this trajectory adds ~8-10KB to every memory-write commit. Triplicate deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md (3 × ~21KB = ~63KB) similarly inflates git history per spec edit. Net runtime impact: zero. Net repo-bloat trajectory: negative if uncorrected.
key_claims: Template-load path complexity class unchanged (still O(n) over yaml dir)
Two PathBuf::from string substitutions; zero new sort/comparator/heuristic
6 stowaway tmp files = ~55KB per commit; recurring → unbounded growth
Triplicate spec doc = ~63KB per edit cycle; inflates git history quadratically with edit frequency
uncertainty_areas: Whether OMC tooling that emits the .json.tmp residue runs frequently enough to materially impact pack size

findings.summary: Tmp stowaway commits create per-commit ~55KB bloat; trajectory unbounded if not gitignored
findings.recommended_action: Add .omc/*.tmp.* to .gitignore and CI-block reintroduction (already covered by F-PR15-01 stowaway lane)

findings.summary: Triplicate spec doc inflates git history per edit cycle
